name: Montellano (Spain)
description: Blue field with a white band from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Montellano (a castle on white above yellow, with a scroll).
history: Municipal flag of Montellano; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: band from the upper hoist to the lower fly
